prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, over-the-shoulder shot of a person holding a smartphone in their right hand, the screen brightly illuminated and displaying a dating profile on the Plenty of Fish (POF) app. The phone is angled so the viewer can clearly see the profile photo of a man and the app’s interface, with text and images in sharp focus. The person holding the phone is partially visible, with a blurred ear and a lock of blonde hair in the foreground, suggesting they are intently examining the screen. The background is softly out of focus, revealing a grassy surface and a hint of a red sign, evoking an outdoor nighttime setting. The lighting is warm and cinematic, with the phone’s glow casting subtle highlights on the hand and face, while the rest of the scene is bathed in gentle, ambient darkness. The overall color palette features natural greens and browns, punctuated by the cool blue and white light from the phone. The composition uses shallow depth of field to draw attention to the phone’s screen, creating an intimate, voyeuristic mood reminiscent of a modern romantic drama or a slice-of-life film.
